info.title: API.SH: StockX
info.description: The StockX API from API.SH: public StockX data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
A StockX brand page or category page: its products (name, brand, style id, lowest ask, highest bid, last sale, number of asks and bids, sales in the last 72 hours, release date, retail price, image), the totals and the filters the page offers. Takes the same filters and sorts as `/stockx/v1/search`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockx-browse

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: StockX brand id (as in stockx.com/brands/<brand>), e.g. nike, jordan, adidas, new-balance. Brand or category is required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: StockX category id, e.g. sneakers, apparel, accessories, collectibles, trading-cards, electronics. With a brand it narrows the brand page.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A stockx.com/brands/<brand> or stockx.com/category/<category> link, instead of brand or category.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender filter (men, women, child, preschool, toddler, infant, unisex).

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: Condition filter id as StockX uses it.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size filter id as StockX uses it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A StockX product's order book: each price level with the number of open bids or asks at that price and the size it is for. Pass a `variant` id (from `/stockx/v1/product/history` recent sales) for one size only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockx-product-bids

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: StockX product link. url or id is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product url key or product uuid, instead of url.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: Variant (size) uuid for one size only.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency code (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, ...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: StockX price history and recent sales
get.description:
A StockX product's sale price history (average sale price per interval over the chosen range), its most recent sales (price, size, time, order type) and sale statistics (12-month low and high, 90-day low, high, average and number of sales, volatility, price premium). Pass a `variant` id from `recent_sales` for one size only. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockx-product-history

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product URL key or product id instead of url.

parameters.name: variant
parameters.description: A size's variant id (from recent_sales[].variant_id) for that size's history.

parameters.name: intervals
parameters.description: Points in the price history (1-400; default by range).

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Currency (default USD): USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, JPY, CHF, SGD, HKD, KRW, NZD, MXN, CNY, SEK, DKK, NOK, PLN.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products related to a StockX product: the other colorways of the same design (family=design) or other products in the same colour family (family=color), each with its lowest ask, brand, category and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockx-product-related

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: StockX product link. url or id is required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product url key or product uuid, instead of url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/stockx-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: sneakers, apparel, shoes, accessories, collectibles, trading-cards, electronics, or a sub-category (lifestyle, performance, tops, bags…).

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brand slug(s), comma separated (e.g. jordan, nike, adidas).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size value(s) as StockX lists them.

parameters.name: size_type
parameters.description: StockX size type(s), e.g. men, women, gs.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
